about: Lane SPECIES-ANIM-B2 (2026-11-24, coordinator after SIG7): the 18 cat breeds aboard as species of their own (Abyssinian to Turkish Van) take the domestic cat's row, its sleep row and its sentences, as SIG7's coat variants do (`coats` in signature-recipes-sig7.json), less the acts on clips their live v3 rigs lack. Each breed's rig (ark-rig/v3 manifest, 2026-11-24) has lie but no dig, knead or stretch clip, so the loaf comes in and the scrape, the knead and the stretch stay out. `over`: the breeds have generated rows of their own (#112), a plain quadruped's; the cat's row replaces them. Applied by scripts/ark-signature-recipes.mts. Strips: ~/AnimalDex-work/species-anim-b2/cats/.
